scope: Phase 1 only. Pending subjects block --all. Proposed dispositions require register validation. Qualitative review is never a runtime pass.

rules.title: "Var only when the type is apparent"
"Target-typed new only where var cannot be used"
"Expression bodies only for properties and accessors"
"XML docs on public types and members"; "XML docs and comments"
"No comments inside member bodies"; "XML docs and comments"
"Member body of 60 lines or fewer"; "Member body length"
"Property names in camelCase and enums as their pinned names"
"Unknown is the zero value and never valid"
"Every external dependency has a health check"
"One tag per health check, matching its failure status"

uniquenessPolicy: Reject all duplicate keys, pins, case IDs and candidates, including identical declarations; do not pick a winner.
